unresolved: StringCopyWithBufferRealloc's destination buffer is opaque in the raw C; the string-field offsets inside vehicle_list_node / name_list_node / scene_list_node cannot be pinned. Only the explicit dword/byte sentinel writes are recorded as layouts.

The signature is presented for the packet's core entry sub_415230 only. The cluster has heterogeneous calling conventions: __thiscall (list builders, constructors, sub_4186F0, sub_41F8A0, sub_420CF0), __stdcall (ID lookups, wrappers), __fastcall (sub_41F340, sub_41F5D0, sub_420820).

Whether sub_415780 / sub_4159B0 / sub_415C40 operate on three embedded lists of one shared content-registry object (slots at this+0x00, this+0x10, this+0x20) or on three unrelated containers is not provable from the packet; the container constructors are outside the packet.

The seven identical wrappers: distinct address per function but identical body. Whether each is a separately registered path-category callback or the same thunk duplicated is unresolved without their callers.
The object at overlay_display+0xAF8 and its vtable slots (+0x04 draw, +0x08 query, +0x18 update) are unknown; the overlay_display type name is DERIVED.

The hardcoded ID tables in the four lookups and the record IDs 423/424/488 (sub_420820) and 492/496/500/504 (sub_420CF0) are literal constants; their semantics (display vs internal ID, year/variant meaning of a3/a4/a5) are inferred from branch structure only.
